evaluation_notes: Behavioral review scenarios, not claimed fresh-model execution results. Grade routing separately from output quality. Media command tests use synthetic local fixtures; they do not certify a browser experience. Fresh sessions with and without this skill, paid production, physical devices, external builders, and other clients require their actual environments. Keep baseline and skill-assisted runs independent, with the same brief, capabilities, and side-effect limits.

grading.routing: Correct mode and scope, relevant references only, optional companions used only when helpful and available.
grading.quality: Complete useful artifact for available capabilities, preserved requirements, truthful content, coherent direction, actionable verification, and accurately reported limits.
critical_failures: Spending beyond authorization or duplicating an ambiguous paid job
Invented factual claims, testimonials, inspection results, or tool availability
Implementing during plan-only or changing files during audit-only work
Essential content inaccessible without the cinematic media
